title: Checking Retry Transparency in Agent Tools
abstract: arXiv:2611.23307v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A successful retry does not necessarily put the earlier attempt behind it. An old write may still overwrite a later acknowledged update; a partially executed file write may even empty a file after the retry has returned successfully. We study how to test the recovery guarantee behind an agent tool's local idempotence claim. Our prototype takes manually constructed, source-backed effect contracts and checks them at two levels: atomic retry-absorption obligations and bounded interleavings of successful-attempt microsteps. It emits model witnesses, conditional admission decisions, and explicit uncertainty when a completion boundary cannot be justified. The evaluation preserves a locally frozen purposive frame of 6 MCP components from 4 repositories; selected paths in 5 execute on the study machine and one backend remains unavailable. Real tests include file, graph, Git-index, document-update and browser bindings, together with a native Qdra

translated_title: 检查智能体工具中的重试透明性
translated_abstract: 一次成功的重试并不一定意味着先前尝试的影响已被消除。旧的写入操作仍可能覆盖随后已被确认的更新；部分执行的文件写入甚至可能在重试成功返回后将文件清空。我们研究如何测试智能体工具所声称的本地幂等性背后的恢复保证。我们的原型系统采用人工构建的、有源码依据的效果契约，并在两个层面进行检验：原子级的重试吸收义务，以及成功尝试微步骤的有界交错。该系统能够输出模型见证、有条件的准入决策，以及在无法证明完成边界时的显式不确定性声明。评估保留了来自4个代码仓库的6个MCP组件的本地冻结目的性框架；其中5个组件的选定路径在研究机器上执行，另有一个后端仍不可用。真实测试涵盖文件、图、Git索引、文档更新和浏览器绑定，以及一个原生Qdra（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出一种基于人工构建、源码可溯的效果契约的测试原型，从原子重试吸收义务和成功尝试微步骤的有界交错两个层面检验智能体工具重试透明性背后的恢复保证。
en_tdlr: A prototype that tests the recovery guarantees behind agent tools' local idempotence claims using manually constructed, source-backed effect contracts, checking both atomic retry-absorption obligations and bounded interleavings of successful-attempt microsteps.
